subject: ist-s-algn
title: IST.S.ALGN.------C.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 28 (BK(NM)-4). IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-INFO (composite information) is the partner. From the subject: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation) and EXT-F (extended functionalism). From MT-INTR: TRS (transition) and INFO-DY. From INFO-DY: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: PRI-INFO-TD and P-PROG (particular progressionalism). From P-PROG: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: IST-F (isolated focus). From EXT-F: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
